content:
The image shows a mango leaf with whitish-grey powdery patches scattered across the upper leaf surface. The patches are irregular, dusty/mealy in texture, and distributed across the leaf blade. There is no black sooty coating (ruling out Sooty Mould), no sunken brown/dark spots with halos (ruling out Anthracnose), and no bark discoloration or gum secretion (ruling out Die Back).

The white powdery surface deposits are characteristic of powdery mildew fungal growth.
